name: TrustDemoDT01
title: TD.DT.01 What does a scanned DVC become in the child's record?
description: From the result of reading one foreign DVC, decide whether its dose is recorded as verified, kept as reported and not verified, or not recorded from it at all. Requirements: STT-VER-001, STT-VER-006, STT-VER-008, STT-VER-011. Hit policy FIRST: the rules are tried in order and the first that matches applies.

action.title: Rule 1
action.description: When result is unverified: outcome = reported-unverified; action = Save the dose as reported by the family (primarySource false, the caregiver as information source, a note that nothing is verified) and refer the child to the clinic for verification. The CHW's triage read in J2 (STT-VER-011): nothing is verified, so the dose is reported, never verified. Example Immunization TrustDemoJ2HepBReported.

action.title: Rule 2
action.description: When result is verified: outcome = verified; action = Import the dose with primarySource true and a verification Provenance that names the signer's key and removes the reported dose it replaces; then map its vaccine code (TD.DT.02). J3's yes path (STT-VER-001): the dose is recorded from its primary source. Examples Immunization TrustDemoJ3HepB and Provenance TrustDemoJ3Verification.

action.title: Rule 3
action.description: When result is failed and failureReason is KidNotFound: outcome = reported-unverified; action = Keep the dose as reported; record the step and reason (STT-VER-008); verify the DVC again after the next trust-list refresh. The signer's certificate is not in the clinic's cached trust list (STT-VER-006), for example a signer added after the last refresh: J3's no path "until the next refresh".

action.title: Rule 4
action.description: When result is failed and failureReason is one of Expired, NotYetValid: outcome = reported-unverified; action = Keep the dose as reported; record the step and reason; the clinician decides by national policy whether to give or repeat the dose. The signature verified, but the certificate is outside its validity period. The dose is not verified; the clinician decides by national policy.

action.title: Rule 5
action.description: When result is failed and failureReason is one of BadPrefix, UnsupportedContextVersion, Base45Invalid, InflateFailed, LimitExceeded, CoseMalformed: outcome = not-read; action = Scan again; if it still fails, treat the card as paper and record why it was not verified. Decoding failed before any signature check (STT-VER-001 order), so nothing was read: three states, not two, since a bad scan is not evidence either way.

action.title: Rule 6
action.description: When result is failed: outcome = rejected; action = Do not record a dose from this certificate; record the step and reason; the clinician decides by national policy, as for an undocumented dose. Any other failure (signature, key usage, header, algorithm, hcert claim or payload): the certificate is not evidence of a dose.
